prompt_md: You roll a fair six-sided die over and over. On average, how many rolls does it take until you've seen every face at least once?
prompt_short: Average rolls of a die to see all six faces?
hint_md: How long does each new face take, once you've seen some?
explain_intuition_md: The first roll is always new, but new faces get harder to find. With five seen, only 1 roll in 6 brings the last one, and that alone takes 6 rolls on average. Adding up the wait for each new face gives 14.7.
